win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - FORTUNE IS BLIND
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the SHE WHO SPINS bonus. In addition, 3 Fortuna Wheels are guaranteed to be triggered every spin!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

multipliers.name: FORTUNA WHEELS
multipliers.behavior:
A Fortuna symbol can land on reels 1, 3 and 5. Fortuna symbols can be Regular, Super or Epic. Only 1 Fortuna symbol can land on a reel at a time. When the symbol lands, all regular payline wins will be handled before a Fortuna Wheel of equivalent level is triggered in the same grid position as the Fortuna symbol.

 When Fortuna Wheels activate, they will start spinning. When the Wheel stops, the arrow will point to one of the 12 slices on the Wheel, and the value of that slice will be collected as a cash prize by the Cash Prize Bar. If the arrow lands on an additive Multiplier, it will be added to the value in the Cash Prize Bar. If the arrow lands on a multiplicative Multiplier, it will multiply the value displayed in the Cash Prize Bar.

 Regular Fortuna Wheels can contain the following values:

 Additive Multipliers: 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x 
 Multiplicative Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20 

 Super Fortuna Wheels can contain the following values:

 Additive Multipliers: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x 
 Multiplicative Multipliers: x3, x4, x5, x10, x20 

 Epic Fortuna Wheels can contain the following values:

 Additive Multipliers: 25x, 50x, 100x 
 Multiplicative Multipliers: x5, x10, x20 

 All Fortuna Wheels can contain one Jackpot prize slice. If the arrow lands on a Jackpot prize slice, one of the four following Jackpot prize values will be selected from the Jackpot sign outside of the grid before being collected by the Cash Prize Bar as an additive Multiplier:

 Mini: 25x 
 Major: 100x 
 Mega: 500x 
 Max win: {maximumWinMultiplier}x 

 The Cash Prize Bar is located outside of the grid. If there is one Fortuna Wheel on the grid, the Cash Prize Bar collects the Multiplier value as a cash prize. If there are multiple Fortuna Wheels on the grid, the values of the Wheels are collected as cash prizes from left-to-right. evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Legends speak of a goddess who reigns over fortune, and whose mere presence has inspired stories for generations!

 Forget the horseshoes and four-leaf clovers, this is a new chapter of the legend. Step into the Rise of Fortuna, a realm where Lady Fortuna rules on her own and where the story of fate unfolds. Cross your fingers and you might get lucky enough to meet the goddess of fate and fortune herself.

 Rise of Fortuna is a 5-reel, 4-row game with payline wins and a blessed max win of {maximumWinMultiplier} times your bet available in all game modes!
